_comment: Reviewed original local-vars that no op assigns on the PC port, zero-filled at entry on Dreamcast (AI-assisted). Each entry names the function, its locals and why; "assigned_elsewhere": true marks locals the original sets on other paths but reads stale on one. Anything not listed still refuses as an uninitialized read. lower_sh4_ir.py --unassigned-locals checks every listed local exists and is never assigned; build_game_cgo.py reports entries no file used. "false_locals" lists locals that start as #f instead of 0 (a stale value only ever tested for truth). "call_args": true marks a function that passes a never-assigned (local-vars (x none)) as a call argument, which the frontend gives a register of its own; that register starts as 0.

process-particles.reason: sparticle.gc: the PC port comments out the original (.mfc0 gp-0 Count) / (.mfc0 v1-29 Count) cycle-counter reads; their difference only feeds a profiling stat. Desktop reads garbage; Dreamcast reads 0.

(method find-overlapping-shapes collide-.reason: collide-shape.gc: when tlist is #f, (b! (= a0-10 #f) cfg-11 :delay (set! v1-2 #t)) jumps to cfg-11, which tests s2-0 without setting it on that path; the PS2 and desktop read whatever the register last held (the previous loop iteration's value). Dreamcast: zero at entry, then the slot keeps its value across iterations like the register.

(method update-vis-volumes level-group).reason: entity.gc:434-441: the source notes an original GOAL compiler bug. v1-10 is read inside its own assignment ((set! sv-16 (the-as process v1-10))) and sv-16 is overwritten with s0-1 on the next line, so that stale value is never used. sv-16 is also tested by (when sv-16 ...) on the path where that when was false, reading the previous iteration's stack value or, the first time, an unset one. Dreamcast: v1-10 starts 0; sv-16 starts #f, so a first iteration without a process-drawable skips the update instead of calling it on garbage.

birth-pickup-at-point.reason: collectables.gc:1381-1388: the same original compiler pattern as update-vis-volumes, once per pickup type. Each v1-N is read inside its own (set! v1-N (when sv-64 ...)) as (set! sv-192 (the-as (pointer process) v1-N)), and sv-192 is overwritten with (-> sv-64 ppointer) before any use. Dreamcast: zero at entry.

draw-subtitle.reason: subtitle.gc: the (when ...) body ends in (#when PC_SUBTITLE_DEBUG ...), which compiles to nothing, so the true path never sets the returned value; desktop returns whatever rax held. Both callers discard it. Dreamcast: the value starts as #f, the false path's value.

beach-obs:anon-function-16.reason: beach-obs.gc flutflutegg :trans: the cond's (if (play-ambient ...) (logior! ...)) branches set nothing when play-ambient answers #f, so the returned value is unset on those paths; a :trans behavior's value is never used. Starts as #f (AI-assisted).

fisher:anon-function-2.reason: fisher.gc fisher-fish-die :code: the case's ('deadly 'bad) branch does nothing, so the returned value is unset on that path; a state's :code value is never used. Starts as #f (AI-assisted).

misty-obs:anon-function-0.reason: misty-obs.gc boatpaddle-idle :code: (the float s4-0) reads last frame's value, set later in the loop; on the first pass the original reads whatever the register held. It only offsets part 943's initial value. Dreamcast reads 0 (AI-assisted).

target-tube:anon-function-18.reason: target-tube.gc slide-control-ride :trans: the cond's first clause has no body, so the returned value is unset when its test fails over to nothing; a :trans behavior's value is never used. Starts as #f (AI-assisted).

rolling-race-ring:anon-function-1.reason: rolling-race-ring.gc race-ring :trans: the cond's first clause ((not (last-ring? self))) has no body, so the returned value is unset on that path; a :trans behavior's value is never used. Starts as #f (AI-assisted).

swamp-rat-nest-spawn-rat.reason: swamp-rat-nest.gc: (local-vars (t2-0 none)), never assigned, is passed as swamp-rat-init-by-other's fifth argument (arg4: when true the rat is not actor-paused); the original passes whatever register t2 held. Dreamcast passes 0, which GOAL reads as true: spawned rats are never actor-paused (AI-assisted).

billy:anon-function-23.reason: billy.gc enter-playing :trans: the cond's (else) has no body, so the returned value is unset on that path; a :trans behavior's value is never used. Starts as #f (AI-assisted).

assistant-citadel:anon-function-0.reason: assistant-citadel.gc assistant-lavatube-end hidden :trans: the closing (when (and ...)) has no body, so the returned value is unset when the test fails; a :trans behavior's value is never used. Starts as #f (AI-assisted).

robotboss-misc:anon-function-2.reason: robotboss-misc.gc cam-robotboss :enter: the cond's first clause ((-> self enter-has-run)) has no body, so the returned value is unset on that path; an :enter behavior's value is never used. Starts as #f (AI-assisted).

sage-finalboss:anon-function-2.reason: sage-finalboss.gc plat-eco-finalboss plat-path-active :enter: the cond's first clause ((arg0)) has no body, so the returned value is unset on that path; an :enter behavior's value is never used. Starts as #f (AI-assisted).
